title: Audit Document Access in Files
description: Complete the audit document access workflow in the Files module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with admin access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Files module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for audit document access are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Files module from the main navigation.
Locate the audit document access entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for audit document access.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Audit Document Access completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Files views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during audit document access.
Permission constraints prevent completion of audit document access.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun audit document access.
Confirm role permissions for admin and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun audit document access?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm audit document access is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
